CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed in units per second. The fractal is small — keep this low (0.05–0.4) to stay inside.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of the neon pulse seam travelling through the fractal surface. 0 = static colour.
CONTROLS.NAME: colour_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Temporal blur — blends current frame with previous. Higher = smoother, more trails.
CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of brightness pulse on bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity
